One thing in this picture costs you a whole day in Japan. Three things to sort before you land.

One. Your suitcase. Japan will move it for you. You hand it in at your hotel in the morning, and it's waiting at the next one the following day. About three thousand yen, and you take the train with just a bag.
Two. Your bank card. Japanese bank machines won't take a card from home. The cash machines inside seven eleven will, and they run all night.
Three. The last train. It goes around midnight, and nothing runs again until five in the morning. After ten, a taxi adds twenty percent on top.
Save this for your Japan trip.
